senses.sense_definition: An item of clothing worn underneath outer clothes, especially next to the skin.

examples.text: Thermal <w>undergarments</w> are essential when working outside during freezing winter conditions.
She bought a supportive silk <w>undergarment</w> to wear beneath her formal evening gown.

senses.sense_definition: A sacred type of underwear worn by adherents of the Latter-day Saint movement after participating in certain temple ceremonies.

examples.text: Devout members consider the sacred <w>undergarment</w> a deeply personal reminder of their religious covenants.
He always treated his religious <w>undergarment</w> with great reverence and care.
